newsitem.title: TURKEY: Conference analysts say no central bank gold sales.
newsitem.headline: Conference analysts say no central bank gold sales.

text.p: Western gold analysts and traders said on Wednesday talk of recent or current gold sales by central banks was totally unconfirmed and they did not expect any such sales.

"Such talk is totally unconfirmed and we cannot know of any such sales until its impact on the market is over," an analyst from an international gold body told Reuters on the sidelines of an international gold conference in Istanbul.
"We don't think any central banks are in the market now or have been recently," said another analyst.
Market rumours say some central banks might have sold gold in the market or among themselves. The Belgian central bank sold about 200 tonnes of gold earlier this year.

Belgian National Bank governor Alfons Verplaetse said in a newspaper interview on Monday he was happy with the level of the central bank's gold reserves after sales in recent years and there would be no further sales.
